details:
It's not a bug, but missing feature toggle. And it's for SDK Client Sim so i post here.

ClientSim is nice feature, big thanks. Now we are testing it mostly in Desktop mode, and there seems no option to use VR mode instead of it.

That is because we want also see how scripts works when it's designed for VR mode, especially with _localplayer.IsUserinVR() function. Right now there is nothing to trigger this function. This function separate desktop and vr. 

Some games are based on it to adjust control or adjust HUD view. VR view is much smaller than Desktop view.

Not all creators want put up headset every time just for testing, so yeah, can you make it bit easier for creators? Just add VR mode in ClientSim.

Sure VR mode in Unity is bit weird, but at least we can check something even we cannot use hands - we can still verify it with Scene window to take a look at test avatar.

It just make things easier and possible to check it. Thank you very much.
title: Add toggle to VR mode in Client Sim
